Admin settings

For OSA staff
For OSA staff who keep Pup Pause running. Monthly themes and holidays switch on their own; these settings fine-tune it. Saved settings reach everyone who opens the app signed in to Claude; everyone else sees the built-in calendar.
This week at OSA (optional)
Participation goal
Used for the newsletter line “X% of HGSE has taken a Pup Pause.” It counts each phone or laptop once.
Term dates
These change what Howie says on heavy weeks. The defaults are placeholders — match them to the HGSE academic calendar.
Preview a month
See the app as it will look on another date (decorations, greetings and messages). Only this browser sees the preview, and preview check-ins are kept apart in the data.
Practice mode: answers aren’t saved on this device.
A student prototype for HGSE’s T522 course. Not an official OSA service.
